responsibleAgent.assignedTask: Move VAT handling out of the pricing module.

currentWorkStep.title: Move VAT handling into its own module

feedback.title: VAT extraction leaves the discount order undefined
feedback.body:
## What I looked at

The extraction of VAT handling out of `pricing` into the new `tax` module.

## What stands out

1. **Order of operations is now implicit.** `Total` applies tax before the discount, while the
   old code applied the flat 19 % rate after summing net lines. For percentage discounts this
   changes the result.
2. **No rounding rule is stated.** `tax.For(country).Apply(sum)` returns a `money.Amount`, but
   nothing documents whether it rounds half-up per line or per order.

## Suggestion

Make the sequence explicit and cover it with a table test:

```go
net := order.NetTotal()
discounted := net.Sub(p.discountFor(order))
total := discounted.Add(tax.For(order.DeliveryCountry).Apply(discounted))
```

This is a reported observation, not a measured defect.
